Subject: Helio SIG questionnaire — initial evidence request

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. Our procurement + security teams have reviewed the attached SIG questionnaire (version 3) and flagged the controls where they need substantiation (particularly around encryption-in-transit, key management, and retention/backup controls).

High-level asks:
- Control mapping: please map each SIG control to your internal policy / artifact and indicate test evidence (snapshot, runbook excerpt, or log sample).
- Evidence delivery: we need a staged delivery by EOW (May 14) with an initial package containing high-risk controls.
- Scope clarification: confirm whether the answers cover both the Redwood hosted API and Dedicated deployments (we care about both).

Can you confirm receipt and an owner for the evidence bundle? Also include any point-of-contact for legal/escrow discussions — our legal team will request a brief on retention SLA exceptions.

Attachments: Helio_SIG_Questionnaire_v3.pdf (procurement)

Regards,
Lena Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Helio Financial

Subject: Re: Helio SIG questionnaire — initial evidence request

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Confirmed receipt. Tentative plan:

1) Owner: Marissa Cole will lead the evidence packaging and delivery.
2) Scope: answers will cover Redwood Hosted API and Redwood Dedicated; we'll call out any Dedicated-only configs in the crosswalk.
3) Delivery cadence: initial high-risk control bundle by May 13 COB; full packet by May 14 COB.

I'm attaching our initial control map (Redwood_SIG_Control_Map_v1.xlsx) and a lightweight evidence manifest template (evidence_manifest_template.md) — these will help us align the artifacts to your SIG rows.

We will also surface SOC 2 test windows and KMS proof artifacts where available. Ben will coordinate the KMS/key provenance evidence.

If your legal team needs an escrow/retention summary, loop them to marissa.cole@redwood.com and I will coordinate an internal exception review.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

Redwood Inference

Lena — quick clarification from our side: when you say "retention/backup controls", do you want examples of backup logs/config for the hosted API only, or for Dedicated customer-managed pools as well? For Dedicated, backup/retention policies are often customer-configurable and differ by deployment.

Preliminary notes:
- Encryption-in-transit: we will provide TLS cipher suites, cert rotation schedule, and a packet capture redaction sample (sanitized).
- KMS: we can provide a KMS key policy excerpt and a time-stamped signing log for a recent rotation event — Ben is pulling the rotation audit.

Thanks Kimberly — all good questions. To be explicit: we require evidence for both Hosted API and Dedicated unless an item is explicitly "customer-managed". For customer-managed controls please annotate as "out-of-scope / customer responsibility" in the mapping column.

A couple of additional asks from security:
- For SOC 2: provide the last 12 months of test window dates and the auditor name (if available).
- KMS: the CISO would like a signed timestamp of the most recent key rotation event and the rotation policy excerpt. Redact PII but keep the event hashes.
- Retention/SLA: our legal team will request any proposed exceptions to standard retention — if you can provide a suggested short-form amendment we can route it through procurement.

We are targeting an initial review by May 17 internal Helio security. If you can hit your May 13/14 delivery plan, that should be fine for us.

Regards,
Lena Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Helio Financial
